subject.title: [Feature Request] Add streamTo="parent" support for runtime="subagent"

question: What native subagent progress, if any, may be relayed to a parent session when `streamTo="parent"` is requested?
rationale: The implementation crosses child/parent session and channel boundaries and can expose tool arguments, tool results, command output, paths, patches, approvals, or reasoning-like text.

options.title: Assistant/status only
options.body: Allow bounded assistant/status progress with truncation and redaction, while excluding raw tool arguments, raw tool results, and reasoning-like content by default.

options.title: Verbose parent setting
options.body: Inherit parent verbosity for additional tool summaries only after maintainers define redaction, channel delivery, and audit behavior.

options.title: Keep native completion-only
options.body: Do not add native streaming yet, and instead improve waiting/status indicators without forwarding child progress payloads.

recommendation.title: Assistant/status only
recommendation.body: Allow bounded assistant/status progress with truncation and redaction, while excluding raw tool arguments, raw tool results, and reasoning-like content by default.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a native subagent runtime contract decision, with security review from the adjacent Agents/Security owner.
